description: The executed evidence gate reports TPC-DS Q87 on SQLite failing with 'near EXCEPT: syntax error' on fork wheel 30.24.0.6: SQLite does not accept parenthesised SELECT operands of EXCEPT/INTERSECT/UNION. The fork generator should wrap such operands as subselects. When fixed, remove the Q87 entry from scripts/sql_execution_gate/expected_differences.json.
